title: Cherry Block
description: Friendly and casual, QOL-enhanced survival multiplayer server.
body:
🌸 **Cherry Block** 🌸

_A Cozy Vanilla Survival Experience_

Cherry Block is a community-focused survival server designed for players who appreciate a slower pace. Whether you’re here to master a technical build or simply find a quiet corner to plant a garden, you’ll find a home in our version 26.1.2 world.


**The Experience:**

Enhanced Vanilla: A focus on the core Minecraft loop with only QOL additions.

Cross-Platform: Seamless play between Java and Bedrock.

Atmosphere: A mature, friendly community that values creativity and building.


**Connection Details:**

IP: cherryblock.org
Port (for bedrock users): 25565


**Join the Community:**
discord.gg/cherryblock
